breaking_changes: The /v1/models/{model}/options endpoint's resolved_ctx_size field can now be null instead of always numeric when automatic context sizing cannot fit a valid context — clients parsing it as an integer will fail.
GET on previously-404 POST-only paths (slots/{id}, jobs/{id}/pause|interrupt|resume, models/register) now returns 405 instead of 404.

A request without the model field now raises 'Missing model field in request' consistently on every model route (chat/completions, completions, embeddings, responses, rerank), instead of the old inconsistent error messages.
Form-encoded requests with invalid field types (e.g. non-numeric temperature on transcription) return 400 instead of 500.
Streaming responses now carry a cancel token that stops the server from sending after a TCP disconnect.

evidence.blockers: Strix Halo models (57e63bf) must be verified on 128 GB APU hardware before ship — this is a v2026.44 regression fix. The Windows ROCm re-enablement (1ba79d4) needs a real ROCm-capable Windows machine. The full GUI3 workspace tour (9cfd620-1) and API key persistence (62e4aa6) need end-to-end exercise on a compiled candidate.
evidence.breaking_changes: The resolved_ctx_size null change requires clients to handle non-numeric values; the GET→405 change affects scripts expecting 404; the consistent 'Missing model field' message replaces varied errors; form encoding returns 400 instead of 500; and streaming responses now carry cancel tokens that terminate the stream on disconnect.
evidence.coverage: All 49 commits from v2026.43.3 to aab9c362 reviewed; 32 items rated from 12 commits with 'Needs Attention' verdicts plus 4 clean model additions, 2 CI-only fixes, 1 benchmark fix, 1 ROCm tag fix, and 10 other clean changes with no maintainer to-dos.
evidence.manual_testing: Strix Halo systems (Fedora/Debian) for three large model loads and the resolved_ctx_size integer return. Windows ROCm machine for sd-cpp image generation and MAX_PATH refusal. Tauri desktop app with six workspaces and server connection. Web GUI with Remember API key checkbox in both checked and unchecked states. Microphone dictation across five capability modes. Model updates via the new Update button and Update All.
evidence.security: No new credential handling, network calls, or supply-chain changes observed. The API key persistence (62e4aa6) stores keys in browser localStorage with documented same-origin XSS risk for web clients. The model deletion fix (0100ec6) reads from disk instead of trusting the JSON catalog, reducing trust in untrusted data. The ROCm DLL staging (1ba79d4) mitigates Windows DLL hijacking by bundling known-good runtime DLLs.
